name: Devoted Heart
descriptionTemplate: At the end of each turn, the corresponding Awakener who played the last Command Card gains 20 Aliemus. If they also possess the Relic {Mother Effigy}, other Awakeners gain 5 Aliemus as well.
lore: "I'll give you anything, anything at all. Please spare me."
